title: U.S. Auctions 31.5 Million Acres of Pacific Ocean to Deep Sea Mining Company
summary_full: The first-ever lease sale took place over the objections of a federal judge. Wetstone U.S. Ventures paid $6 million to lease the seabed for mapping and preparation, not actual mining.
